answer: PoA resists Sybil control by binding each identity to bonded collateral and detecting shared equivocation: if k coordinated identities sign conflicting histories, the correlated penalty grows as O(k^2), not merely per signer. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier across linked escrows, making a swarm costlier than isolated keys; delta records the fault window, crystal commits the evidence, and the ledge marks the minimum collateral floor.
